assay: bulk RNA-seq, mouse gastrocnemius muscle, male C57BL/6J, 21 weeks diet, GRCm38.p6 featureCounts (S2.1.p1, S2.7.p1, S2.2.p1)
sample_inclusion: 18 RNA-seq libraries from three groups, n = 6 each: C (chow), H (HFD), HM (HFD + MICT) (S2.7.p1, S3.2.p1)
sample_exclusion: CM group (chow + MICT) is not described among the RNA-seq groups; PCA and both DEG sets name only C, H and HM (S3.2.p1). No sample exclusions are reported.

factors.name: grp
factors.meaning: diet (C vs H) and exercise under HFD (H vs HM)

primary_estimand: Effect of 8-week MICT on the gastrocnemius transcriptome of HFD-fed mice: HM vs H (S3.2.p1, S4.p7-S4.p8). The diet effect H vs C is the paper's first contrast (S3.2.p1).
planned_contrasts: grp_HM_vs_H (exercise under HFD; primary for this request; paper: 563 DEGs, S3.2.p1)
grp_H_vs_C (HFD vs chow; paper: 458 DEGs, S3.2.p1)

blocking_or_covariance.note: independent animals; no subject, batch or time-series structure reported (S2.1.p1, S2.7.p1)

matrix_scale: raw counts (S2.7.p1: raw counts used as DESeq2 input)
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.22.2 on raw counts, Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment (S2.7.p1). The paper does not state a design formula; the contrasts are the group comparisons.
paper_enrichment: GO and KEGG ORA of the DEGs with clusterProfiler v3.10.1 (S2.7.p1; S3.3-S3.4); no GSEA
